findings.message: The batch-size control and the 'New run, keep old path' kept path were not sampled. Batch size is the stochastic part of the request, so the scene's claim that a smaller batch gives a noisier path is not shown in any capture.

In the initial state the purple Next step arrow and the dark Full-batch step arrow almost completely overlap, so their difference is hard to see. Their two labels also sit close to the Lowest point label, but all three can still be read.

The run is called 'converged' and stops while the ball is still about z≈0.5 from the lowest point (loss 0.061). The band |0.5 z|<0.35 lets it stop with a visible gap. The assumptions disclose this band, but a learner may read 'converged' as 'reached the minimum'. A narrower band, or letting the ball keep wandering instead of stopping, would match SGD better.
Some segments of the orange path that zigzag across the bowl are drawn much thinner than others, close to hairlines, but the path is still easy to follow.
